lead_raw_text:
The structure of MnAg₂S₃ crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1 (No. 1), with a unit cell containing six atoms—one Mn, two Ag, and three S—distributed across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers coordinated by three S neighbors (2.3695–2.3785 Å), while Mn centers have six geometric neighbors (two Ag and four S, 2.2973–2.7048 Å) and S centers exhibit four- or five-coordinate environments. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected, spanning all six unit-cell sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between Mn six-vertex polyhedra and Ag three-vertex polyhedra, and corner-sharing between Mn six-vertex polyhedra.
